records.name: UIX Escape and display-order registries
records.purpose: Coordinate global Escape handling by priority and track display order within named groups.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). Exports ESCAPE_PRIORITIES; EscapeRegistry/createEscapeRegistry/escapeRegistry; EscapeListener; and DisplayOrderRegistry/createDisplayOrderRegistry/displayOrderRegistry. EscapeRegistry registers and unregisters primary/secondary numeric priorities; an Escape key invokes only the callback with the greatest primary and then greatest secondary value. The document keydown listener is guarded and installed only while handlers exist. DisplayOrderRegistry records number IDs by group. Constants are SIDEBAR 100, DIALOG 300, IMAGE 400, MENU 500, OVERLAY_PANEL 600, TOOLTIP 1200. Root and ./escape mappings are source/configuration evidence; no blanket SSR guarantee is claimed.
